upcoming.name: AROUND THE BAY 220km - structured endurance ride
upcoming.description:
Start 5:30am Albert Park. Endurance ride, not a race. Steps are time-based, so ferry and rest-stop pauses don't matter, just pick up the next block.

Targets (FTP 250W): flat up to 190W, climbs up to 225W seated and smooth, HR mostly under 145. Sit in groups, don't chase surges.
Fuel: 20-25g carbs every 20 min (60-75g/hr), 400-500ml/hr, refill at every stop.
Body: change hand position every 10 min, stand briefly every 30-45 min. Note any hip or back/neck signs.
Final 60-90 min: if HR is under 140 at 190W and all is well, you can lift to 190-205W. Otherwise hold Z2.

Hour 1 - Settle (cap 175W)
3x
- 20m 55-70% Fuel 20-25g + sip

Hours 2-4 - Steady
9x
- 20m 60-75% Fuel 20-25g + sip

Hours 5-7 - Hold
9x
- 20m 60-75% Fuel 20-25g + sip

Final 60-90 min - Finish
- 90m 60-82% Fuel on timer

upcoming.name: NY Prep Consolidation Long Run — 28km (22km Easy + 6km HR 165-172)
upcoming.description:
NY Marathon Build — Week 6 Consolidation Long Run
Post-peak long run. Hilly route. Target 150m elevation gain.

- 22km Z1 HR (cap 155)
- 6km Z3 HR (165-172bpm)

Step back from last week's 37km. Body absorbing peak load — run by feel and HR throughout. First 22km easy — HR cap 155. Progressive finish at 165-172bpm — lighter than peak week. If legs feel heavy from the peak, stay at the lower end of the range. Pace is the outcome.
© Coach Helmot

upcoming.name: NY Taper Sharpener — 10km Continuous @ 5:42-5:47/km
upcoming.description:
NY Taper — Race Sharpener
10km continuous at marathon effort. Start at 5:47/km — do not go faster. Build to 5:42/km by km 5 and hold through km 10.

- 10km 5:42-5:47/km Pace

On fresh taper legs this should feel like RPE 6-7. HR should sit 165-172 — if it climbs above 172 ease back. This is a confidence session not a fitness session. Smooth, controlled, purposeful.
© Coach Helmot
